fact: The National Health Development Plan 2023-2032 states that the Ministry of Health approved the nationwide use of DHIS2 in 2020, that two years after implementation its use covers only the vaccination, reproductive health, tuberculosis, HIV/AIDS and malaria programmes with no official plan to extend it, that the SIS is supported by WHO, Gavi, UNFPA and UNICEF, and that the plan provides for a national SIS strategy and for evaluating the pilot of the single clinical process at Hospital Ayres de Menezes and the Água Grande Health Area before expanding it to the whole health system.
title: National Health Development Plan São Tomé and Príncipe 2023 - 2032: More and Better Health for All
publisher: Ministério da Saúde de São Tomé e Príncipe
